description: He asks how to say ταῦτα in 1 John 2:1. The app speaks modern Greek (the request says so), so the answer says how it sounds in modern Greek (TAF-ta, the αυ as 'af' before τ) and never the Erasmian 'TOW-ta'.

request.greek: Τεκνία μου ταῦτα γράφω ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ ἁμάρτητε Καὶ ἐάν τις ἁμάρτῃ παράκλητον ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα Ἰησοῦν χριστὸν δίκαιον
request.english: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father — Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
request.question: How do I say ταῦτα?
